headline: Chevron Divests Energy Assets in Azeri Oil Field to MOL
summary:
Chevron CVX sold its Azerbaijan oil assets to energy company MOL Hungarian Oil and Gas Plc in a $1.57-billion deal. The deal involves the sale of a 9.57% interest in the Azeri-Chirag-Deepwater Gunashli (“ACG”) oil fields (including interests in the Western Export Route Pipeline) and 8.9% interest in the Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan (“BTC”) oil pipeline located in Azerbaijan. The deal provides Chevron with the much-needed cash at a time when oil is facing a historic slump.
